name: petite amie magique ~Madoka to Homura no Shiken Shuukan~
original_name: petite amie magique ～まどかとほむらの試験週間～
source:
Defeating Walpurgis Night, Homura rescued Madoka from her harsh fate.
It has been one year since then――.
The two reciprocated each others’ feelings, and spent their days in peace and happiness.
What new trials will befall upon them…!?
